format: Static scientific figures; PNG and editable SVG; figures sized 8.5 inches wide

captions.01_kernel_speed: Each cell is the median of seven adjacent baseline/candidate time ratios, using the fixed C4 batch count. Same binary64 bits required. Colors are log2 ratios, values are direct ratios. Changing-state and JVP-reuse workloads are distinct.
captions.02_history_speed: Four fixed existing physical inputs. Points show median paired speedup; error bars are Q1-Q3, not confidence intervals. All 24 representative scientific receipts matched within release. Output, birth, certificate and driver counter fields retained.
captions.03_parallel_throughput: Each batch runs the four fixed workloads in input order. New pool creation is included in latency. Error bars are Q1-Q3 over seven fixed batches. Unequal task durations, pool overhead and shared-container noise limit scaling; no portable speedup claim.
